note: Why cells of the Dutchman fixture scoreboard stop, per program: reason codes ranked by how many cells each blocks. Each cell counts once, under its first stop. Static, read-only, public.

owners.explain: cadmpeg (the file reader) does not read this part of the file yet.
Dutchman reads it but has no rule to turn it into a SolidCraft feature yet.
SolidCraft refused the feature, or rebuilt a different shape than the original.
The fixture file or the way it was built is the problem, not the converter.
Nobody has traced this reason to an owner yet.

assembly-no-parts.title: Assembly places no parts
assembly-no-parts.explain: The assembly has no placed parts, so there is nothing to rebuild.

base-feature-empty.title: Base feature gives no solid
base-feature-empty.explain: The first feature produced no solid body that SolidCraft can import.

body-reference-missing.title: Body or topology reference missing
body-reference-missing.explain: The feature depends on an earlier body, edge or face that Dutchman cannot name yet.

chamfer-unresolved.title: Chamfer not resolved
chamfer-unresolved.explain: The chamfer's dimensions cannot be resolved against the model yet.

edge-identity.title: Edge identity not resolved
edge-identity.explain: A fillet or chamfer edge cannot be tied back to geometry in the source file.

extrude-unsupported.title: Extrude kind not supported
extrude-unsupported.explain: This extrude end, face or profile region is not mapped or could not be confirmed yet.

face-edge-ref.title: Face or edge reference not resolved
face-edge-ref.explain: The feature points at a face or edge that cadmpeg does not resolve to the model yet.

face-unresolved.title: Face not resolved
face-unresolved.explain: The feature's face cannot be resolved against the rebuilt model.

feature-not-mapped.title: Feature not mapped yet
feature-not-mapped.explain: Dutchman has no rule for this feature type yet.

fillet-unsupported.title: Fillet kind not supported
fillet-unsupported.explain: Variable-radius fillets and tangency weights are not mapped yet.

hole-unresolved.title: Hole placement not resolved
hole-unresolved.explain: The hole's face, end or placement cannot be resolved against the model.

loft-sections.title: Loft section count
loft-sections.explain: A loft needs between two and fifty sections.

model-check-fails.title: Read model fails its checks
model-check-fails.explain: cadmpeg read the file, but its model of it fails internal consistency checks.

native-not-mapped.title: Native feature not read
native-not-mapped.explain: This program's own feature type has no neutral form in cadmpeg yet.

no-reader.title: No reader for this file type
no-reader.explain: Dutchman cannot open this kind of file yet, so no feature was even tried.

no-reference-shape.title: Original shape cannot be compared
no-reference-shape.explain: The original geometry opens as empty shells, so the rebuilt shape cannot be checked against it.

no-solids.title: No solids or surfaces read
no-solids.explain: cadmpeg found no solid bodies or surfaces in this file that SolidCraft can import.

parts-missing.title: Assembly parts not found
parts-missing.explain: The assembly was saved without its part files next to it, so none could be loaded.

parts-placed-only.title: Parts placed as shapes only
parts-placed-only.explain: No part's history was written; the parts were placed as geometry without an editable timeline.

pattern-unsupported.title: Pattern not supported
pattern-unsupported.explain: The pattern repeats nothing, has no resolved direction, or repeats a body Dutchman cannot name.

revolve-unresolved.title: Revolve not resolved
revolve-unresolved.explain: The revolve's profile, axis or two-sided turn directions cannot be resolved.

sc-refused-fillet.title: SolidCraft: fillet does not fit
sc-refused-fillet.explain: SolidCraft refused a fillet that is larger than the faces beside its edges allow.

sc-refused-profile.title: SolidCraft: no closed profile
sc-refused-profile.explain: SolidCraft refused the feature because its sketch has no closed profile.

sc-refused-thread.title: SolidCraft: thread start unclear
sc-refused-thread.explain: SolidCraft refused a thread because it cannot tell which end the thread starts from.

sc-replay-bodies.title: Rebuilt body count differs
sc-replay-bodies.explain: SolidCraft's replay made a different number of bodies than the original has.

sc-replay-position.title: Rebuilt body sits elsewhere
sc-replay-position.explain: SolidCraft's replay put a body in a different place than the original.

sc-replay-shape.title: Rebuilt body shape differs
sc-replay-shape.explain: SolidCraft's replay made a body whose size, volume or area differs from the original.

sc-step-import-empty.title: SolidCraft imported no body
sc-step-import-empty.explain: SolidCraft could not rebuild a feature because its STEP import produced no bodies.

shape-differs.title: Every feature rebuilt, shape differs
shape-differs.explain: All features rebuilt, yet the written shape differs from the original; the cause is not traced yet.

sheet-metal-unsupported.title: Sheet-metal profile not supported
sheet-metal-unsupported.explain: A sheet-metal flange whose profile is native, not sketch lines and arcs, is not mapped yet.

sketch-no-curve.title: Sketch curve not resolved
sketch-no-curve.explain: A sketch curve has no neutral form that Dutchman can hand to SolidCraft.

sweep-path.title: Sweep path not resolved
sweep-path.explain: The sweep has no path, or its path or swept shape cannot be resolved.

thread-unsupported.title: Modeled thread not supported
thread-unsupported.explain: Modeled (not cosmetic) threads are not mapped yet.

unclassified.title: Not classified yet
unclassified.explain: Dutchman gave a reason that this table has no rule for yet; the cell is listed here until someone adds one.

undecoded-pattern.title: Repeat not decoded
undecoded-pattern.explain: cadmpeg does not decode what a repeated feature repeats, or how, yet.
